{{Top}}
[[File:WA7-NEGTD.png|thumb|200px|A [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]], a model of service droid]]
'''Service droids''', also '''factotum''', '''diner droid''', '''refreshment droid''', '''servant droid''', '''waiter droid''' or '''waitdroid''', were any type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to perform as a [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]], a [[butler]], or to provide any other type of general service. Bartender models were commonly seen in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were known to be smartly programmed to memorize multiple orders with out having to write the order down or forget. They were even programmed to tell the difference between a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] drink and a normal drink.

They were employed in eateries on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. They were used at the banquet held by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] of Taris before the [[Padawan Massacre]].<ref name="KOTOR1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]]</ref>
